items.name: Hack the North
items.description: Canada's biggest hackathon, hosted on UW campus (DC/E7) every September. Home turf — easiest one to get to.

items.name: Terrible Hackathon
items.description: Small, joke-friendly hackathon about making deliberately terrible hacks. Started at UW, but now run in Toronto by Creative Code Toronto (2026 was a one-day event at InterAccess).

items.name: HawkHacks
items.description: Wilfrid Laurier's student hackathon, held right next door in Waterloo.

items.name: Hack the 6ix
items.description: Toronto-based hackathon, industry-sponsor heavy. About a 1-1.5hr drive/GO ride from Waterloo.

items.name: MakeUofT
items.description: University of Toronto's hardware-focused hackathon. Good one if you want to build something physical. 2027 dates TBD — applications open later in the year.

items.name: CxC (UW Data Science Club)
items.description: UW Data Science Club's data science / AI hackathon, usually early February on campus. 2027 dates not announced yet.

items.name: DeltaHacks
items.description: McMaster's flagship hackathon in Hamilton. Under an hour's drive from Waterloo.

items.name: Hack Western
items.description: Western University's hackathon in London. Furthest on this list — still a reasonable ~1.5hr drive.
